steps.title: Text plus a value
steps.say: `+` between a String and a value **joins** them into one String. That's how you label what you print.

marks.label: joins the text and the value

steps.title: Exact output matters
steps.say: The checkpoints read your output, so it must match exactly: capital letters, the colon, the one space.

board.code:
System.out.println("Team number: " + teamNumber);  // Team number: 4143
System.out.println("Team number:" + teamNumber);   // Team number:4143
System.out.println("team number: " + teamNumber);  // team number: 4143
board.caption: Only the first line matches the table.

steps.title: Open Main.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Main` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find it
steps.say: It may be further down. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `Team name:` and press Enter to jump to it.

steps.title: Already in your code
steps.say: The starter already prints two values this way. Your four variables get printed the same way, above it.

steps.title: Run it
steps.say: Click the **Run** button (▷) at the top right of the file. The output appears in the terminal at the bottom.

waitFor.hint: run the program and read the output.
